methods: Independent CUA live desktop and 390x844 home/check inspection with fictional text; check reached evidence and review
Walkthrough route and loaded player inspected
Source review of private Job Loop, public check, CSS and help; viewport override reset
not_tested: Private authenticated UI or customer records
Narrated video playback and caption synchronization

criteria.name: First 30 seconds and navigation
criteria.evidence: Live home names CV plus vacancy task, result and no-account promise; check has six-step rail. JobLoop.tsx:105,350 local section state.

criteria.name: Hierarchy, typography and cohesion
criteria.evidence: Observed clear public green/cream hierarchy; JobLoop.css:1,31,140-146 has blue tokens and 10-12px supporting/consent text.

criteria.name: Mobile usability and accessibility foundations
criteria.evidence: Observed single-column check at390x844 with labels and step grid; CvCheck.tsx:228-229 focus management; long evidence and private small print require further testing.

criteria.name: Effort to first and repeat value
criteria.evidence: Observed role/CV/vacancy screens before first findings; CvCheck.tsx:131,384-390 confirms six initial versus four reuse stages.

criteria.name: Help, errors and recovery
criteria.evidence: Observed empty role validation moves focus to field; walkthrough formats, chapters and transcript available; CvCheck.tsx:401 explains optional refresh recovery.

strengths: Clear first task and no-account public check
Fictional examples and wording-only findings preserve expectation boundaries
Loop source already includes state-dependent next action and saved progress
Task help, video, transcript and untimed interactive steps
Explicit validation focus and recovery choice

findings.problem: A standalone required role screen precedes CV and vacancy before first comparison; friction is a hypothesis, not measured abandonment.

evidence.detail: Fictional task required role, CV text confirmation and vacancy across three screens before findings.
Separate step1 role, step2 CV and step3 vacancy; reuse already groups role and vacancy.

findings.recommendation: Pilot shared CV then role-plus-vacancy intake; require user role confirmation and retain no-CV starter.
acceptance_criteria: One fewer screen before equivalent valid comparison
No increase in incorrect-role or unchecked-source errors in pilot tasks
findings.cost_effect: No new vendor cost; possible lower task effort is unmeasured.

findings.problem: Long mobile findings and a separate whole-CV editor make it costly to keep requirement, source and edit together.

evidence.detail: Four fictional findings form a tall mobile page; review presents full CV text with supporting passages collapsed.
EvidenceResults and continuation render after all findings; step5 places supporting passages in details beside full CV textarea.

findings.recommendation: Add review-count navigation and selected requirement/source/edit context, retaining accessible full document and explicit continuation without requiring every gap to be filled.
acceptance_criteria: Users can trace an edit to the requirement and source without repeated page hunting
Academic and team context stays visible
Full-document review and recheck remain available
findings.cost_effect: No new vendor cost; modest frontend complexity.

findings.problem: Private Loop uses a separate blue palette and consequential support text at11px/consent12px; this is a readability concern, not an asserted WCAG failure.

evidence.detail: Local blue palette differs from green public primary token in src/index.css:13.
Help11px and consent12px; progress detail10px atline31. Mobile inputs are already16px atline191.

findings.recommendation: Use shared semantic tokens and comfortable body scale for permissions/help; reserve tiny text for nonessential metadata; retain mobile16px inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture review at390px and200% zoom has readable permissions, labels and actions without clipping
Public and private primary actions use shared semantic styling

findings.problem: Loop section is local state; section refresh/Back behavior and section-change focus need continuity.

evidence.detail: Section initializes with useState('today'); sidebar section buttons only setTab atline350.
Only a particular Today action explicitly scrolls/focuses; remount would reinitialize section. Live private behavior was not tested.

findings.recommendation: Persist safe section state in route/query without private identifiers, and focus the new section heading after user navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Refresh, Back and help return restore intended section
Existing draft consent and reset safeguards remain intact

findings.problem: Final check step combines many document, format, permission, download and reuse/save decisions simultaneously.

evidence.detail: Step6 combines full CV, optional source reuse, PDF preview/settings, findings, attestations and approval; lines392-395 add formats, next vacancy and account saving. Not live completed.

findings.recommendation: Stage final wording, format/required preview, confirmation/approval and download; show reuse/save after the main outcome while preserving exact-byte checks.
acceptance_criteria: Users can explain remaining prerequisite for disabled downloads
All required exact-byte preview and approvals remain enforced
Edits invalidate old approval and preview
findings.cost_effect: No new service cost; clearer approval hypothesis requires pilot validation.

open_questions: Which finding-to-edit transitions cause difficulty in one task per target audience?
Do mobile users understand which document preview and approval prerequisite remains?
Does the public MBA-student label fit the intended MBA applicant segment?
How does private Loop behave with real keyboard, screen reader and zoom use?
do_not_build_now: AI CV score or authorship percentages
